name: Appearances
overview: Scripture reveals that true value and identity are rooted in being made in God's image, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27, emphasizing that human worth transcends outward appearances. While physical beauty and favor may be fleeting or deceptive, as Proverbs 31:30 teaches, a heart that fears the Lord is truly praiseworthy. Jesus warns against superficial judgments, exhorting believers to avoid judging by outward appearance and instead practice righteous judgment (John 7:24; Matthew 23:28). This calls for discerning beyond external looks to recognize the inward spiritual reality.
